name: Store and return the normalized display name
reason: The behavior requires proving actual stored mutation and equality to the normalized response. The available single-request assertions cannot compare caller-owned state before/after; GET following PATCH would be a workflow. No supported rule constructs a padded nonblank input.

name: Reject invalid names without changing the stored name
reason: Rejection and preservation of the prior stored name must both be checked. The latter needs state comparison or a trusted behavior-specific check, neither representable here; rejection alone would weaken this scenario.

name: Preserve unrelated profile fields
reason: Preserving every other existing profile field needs a baseline and post-update state comparison. No workflow or arbitrary dictionary equality capability is available; a response field alone cannot establish preservation.

name: Reject invalid weights without coercion
reason: Faithful invalid-input coverage needs lower and upper violations, fractional/non-integer values and the explicitly excluded boolean category. These are at least four independent observations, beyond the three-child bound. A single rejection or dropping a category would weaken the behavior.

name: Quote without creating shipments or payments
reason: No HTTP observable establishes absence of shipment/payment creation. Source statements are not runtime evidence, and the supplied implementation command does not establish trusted behavior-specific coverage.

name: Find all matching products after term normalization
reason: All matching and no unrelated products requires collection content/filter comparison, including normalization. Dictionary-only scalar assertions cannot express these array obligations; no reviewed policy supplies normalized search variations.

name: Preserve product fields and code ordering
reason: Array ordering and preservation of every returned product field cannot be represented with dictionary-only scalar assertions. Presence of items would be weaker than the required collection comparison.

name: Return an empty collection for no matches
reason: The schema cannot assert that items is an empty array, and no supplied no-match term or reviewed derivation policy establishes that input. A successful status alone does not preserve this behavior.

name: Reject invalid search terms
reason: The frozen policy supplies no term constraints for generating empty, whitespace and wrong-type search inputs. No concrete invalid request examples are supplied; do not manufacture them or substitute an implementation suite.

name: Leave the catalog unchanged
reason: Catalog nonmutation requires state comparison or a trusted check for that behavior. The HTTP response and implementation-source excerpt do not provide runtime nonmutation evidence.

name: Return a normalized and correctly calculated promotion preview
reason: Canonical LOCAL10 and its tariff are supplied, but no supported derivation constructs the whitespace/case variants required by the normalization behavior. Checking only the canonical code and arithmetic would omit part of the planner intent.

name: Reject invalid promotion codes
reason: The domain-valued promotion code has no reviewed derivation authority or supplied concrete invalid examples. Do not invent an unrecognized code or manufacture blank/wrong-type values for that field.

name: Accept only nonnegative integer subtotals
reason: Acceptance of zero plus rejection of negative, non-integer and explicitly boolean subtotals requires more than three independent observations. Available subtotal derivations cannot remove that complete-decomposition bound.

name: Preview without committing a purchase or consuming the promotion
reason: The HTTP preview has no observable for order/payment creation or promotion consumption. Inferring absence from source or returned totals would substitute repository description for runtime evidence.

name: Allow repeated promotion previews
reason: Repeated preview after a prior preview requires state continuity across requests. Independent composite children do not represent that workflow, and no trusted behavior-specific check is supplied.

name: Store and return supplied boolean choices
reason: The intended behavior includes actual storage, not just echoed boolean fields. Proving stored choices after an update requires a workflow or state-aware trusted check; neither is available in the current representation.

name: Preserve omitted and unrelated preferences
reason: Preserving omitted channels and daily_digest_hour in storage and response requires comparison to prior stored state. A single response or independent requests do not establish that relationship.

name: Reject malformed preference values
reason: The required malformed primitive categories include string, integer, fractional number and null. Faithful independent checks exceed the three-child bound; selecting only some categories would omit stated behavior.

name: Keep invalid updates atomic
reason: Atomicity requires comparing persisted state before and after a mixed valid/invalid update. Status rejection alone cannot establish that no partial change was saved; stateful workflows and trusted coverage are unavailable.
